item.title: 今日早间新闻摘要：聚焦中东战局与能源危机
item.description:
今天早间的重点新闻，浓缩精华，仅需15分钟。本播客内容精选：1) 美国总统特朗普呼吁中止对中东的攻击行动，并表示美国可能很快结束与伊朗的战争；2) 阿联酋和沙特阿拉伯报告称在周一凌晨遭遇了来自伊朗的无人机和导弹袭击；3) 由于中东能源设施遭受攻击，原油价格飙升；4) 美国总统特朗普请求推迟与中国国家主席习近平的峰会，这可能对中美关系带来不确定性；5) 美国股市下跌，国债收益率上升。

特朗普呼吁结束美伊战争：美国总统特朗普表示，他希望在不久的将来能够结束对伊朗的战争，并向盟友和中国寻求帮助以重新开放波斯湾海峡。然而，伊朗否认了这一说法，并继续对其关键能源设施发动攻击。 这反映了美伊之间的紧张局势升级以及全球能源市场的动荡不安。

美国推迟与中国国家主席习近平的峰会：美国总统特朗普请求推迟与中国的国家主席习近平的峰会，这一举动可能对中美关系带来不确定性。尽管如此，中国方面对此表示欢迎。 这突显了国际政治中的复杂动态和各国之间的利益博弈。

伊朗继续对阿联酋能源设施发动攻击：伊朗在波斯湾地区继续对其关键能源设施发动攻击，导致原油价格飙升，并引发了全球市场的担忧。 这加剧了中东地区的紧张局势和能源供应问题。

特朗普预测与古巴达成协议：美国总统特朗普表示，他希望在结束对伊朗的战争后，能够与古巴达成协议。尽管如此，美国政府正在加强对古巴的制裁。 这反映了美国政府在不同地区采取的不同政策和策略。

Trump Calls for Iran De-escalation; Oil and LNG Jump：Today's top stories, with context, in just 15 minutes. On today's podcast: 1) President Trump sought to stop attacks on energy facilities in the Middle East after Israel and Iran struck key targets, fueling concern that a prolonged war will cause lasting damage to oil and gas infrastructure. Iran unleashed waves of retaliatory strikes on projects in Arab countries across the Persian Gulf overnight into Thursday after its prized South Pars gas field — part of the world’s largest gas field shared with Qatar — came under Israeli fire, jolting markets. 2) A Qatari complex housing the world’s largest liquefied natural gas export plant suffered “extensive damage” amid a sharp escalation of attacks on energy facilities across the Persian Gulf. 3) Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell made it clear the US central bank won’t cut interest rates again until inflation resumes cooling. And that’s before it even starts considering the possible impact of the war in the Middle East. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information. 这是当天值得关注的公开 Bloomberg RSS 条目。

Iran Vows Revenge; Trump Says War May End Soon：Today's top stories, with context, in just 15 minutes. On today's podcast: 1) Iranian attacks on Israel and Arab states in the Persian Gulf continued overnight into Wednesday, while President Donald Trump said the US could end the war with the Islamic Republic “in the near future.”Iran launched fresh waves of missile and drone attacks, targeting the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. It also struck Tel Aviv and killed two people. 2) President Donald Trump is desperate to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to ease a growing global energy crisis. He won’t achieve that easily without a ceasefire in the war on Iran.Iran’s sporadic attacks on vessels and the threat of mines have cut traffic in the vital waterway to a trickle, effectively putting Tehran, not outside naval forces, in charge of the flow. The strait carries about a fifth of the world’s oil supplies, and the disruption has led to production cuts, fuel shortages and price increases from Asia to Europe and Africa. 3) Illinois Lieutenant Governor Juliana Stratton won the Democratic nomination for the state’s US Senate seat on Tuesday, beating a rival who far out-spent her and handing a victory to her boss and potential 2028 presidential candidate, Governor JB Pritzker.With more than 80% of the ballots counted, Stratton garnered 40% while Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi took 33%, according to Decision Desk HQ. Representative Robin Kelly, who some Democrats thought would undercut support for Stratton, trailed with 18%. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information. 这是当天值得关注的公开 Bloomberg RSS 条目。
